testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect a nested sketch from the model browser: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:147:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect a nested sketch from the model browser ✔ Given an active part in the MCAD Software contains a dimensioned rectangular sketch used by an extrusion ✔ And the extrusion branch is expanded in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the nested sketch row ✔ Then the sketch row is highlighted ✔ And its rectangular geometry and dimensions appear highlighted in the viewport ✔ And the sketch context menu offers Edit Sketch, Redefine, Share Sketch and Properties ✔ And the menu offers Visibility and Export Sketch As ✔ When the user dismisses the menu and clears the selection ✔ Then the highlighted sketch geometry and dimensions disappear from the viewport ✔ And the solid remains visible
